name: What kind of lighting options are available for a built-in media wall?

mainEntity.name: What kind of lighting options are available for a built-in media wall?

acceptedAnswer.text: Built-in media walls offer various lighting options to enhance aesthetics and functionality. Common choices include recessed LED strip lighting along shelves to highlight decor or media collections, puck lights within cabinets for focused illumination, and backlighting behind the TV or main unit to reduce eye strain and create ambiance. Dimmable options allow you to adjust the mood, while smart lighting can be integrated with your home automation system. When planning, consider how different lighting types will interact with your materials and how they contribute to both accent lighting and practical visibility within the unit.
acceptedAnswer.description: Lighting options for media walls include LED strips for shelves, puck lights for cabinets, and backlighting for ambiance. Dimmable and smart options are available. Consider how lighting enhances materials and functionality.
